verdict.rationale: LibreChat is a self-hosted chat platform rather than a pure coding agent, so publishing an official MCP server is a fair question for it and the axis applies. All the MCP evidence describes LibreChat acting as an MCP client: connecting its agents to external MCP servers, configuring them in librechat.yaml, and adding servers at runtime. Probe-4 points to that same client-integration page and does not show LibreChat exposing its own MCP server endpoint for external agents to connect to, so client-side MCP support cannot be credited here.
